title: The Lipschitz approximation is approximately weakly harmonic
statement: Let n ≥ 1, k ≥ 0, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} any set, W ⊆ U open, R = (M, θ, ξ_R) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n) with μ := R.measure = θHⁿ⌞M (Hⁿ = μHE[n]), κ ∈ ℝ and H : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ^{n+k} μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |H(x)| ≤ κ for all x. Assume R.firstVariation X = −∫⟨X, H⟩dμ for every C¹ compactly supported X with tsupport X ⊆ W, and that x ↦ p_x (projection onto T_xM := approxTangentPlane n M x) is μ-a.e. strongly measurable. Let ξ ∈ ℝ^{n+k}, r > 0 with B_r(ξ) ⊆ W, real numbers e, a, m ≥ 0, T an n-dimensional subspace, ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝᵏ → ℝ^{n+k} linear isometries with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 and ιv ∈ T for all v, w, and f : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ with |f(v) − f(w)| ≤ |v − w| and |f(v)| ≤ r/4 for all v, w. Put Φ(v) := ξ + ιv + ι'f(v), F := Φ(ℝⁿ), fʲ := EuclideanSpace.proj j ∘ f. Assume: (height) |(x − ξ) − p_T(x − ξ)| ≤ r/4 for x ∈ spt μ ∩ B_r(ξ); (tangent identification) for μ-a.e. x ∈ B_r(ξ) and every v with x = Φ(v), f is differentiable at v and T_xM = LinearMap.range(ι + ι'∘Df(v)); θ = 1 μ-a.e. on B_r(ξ); Hⁿ((spt μ ∩ W) ∖ M) = 0; ∫_{B_r(ξ)} Σ_i|p_xe_i − p_Te_i|² dμ ≤ e (lower integral of ENNReal.ofReal; e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1); μ(B_r(ξ) ∖ F) + Hⁿ((F ∖ spt μ) ∩ B_r(ξ)) ≤ a; and μ(B_r(ξ)) ≤ m (the last three as ENNReal inequalities with ENNReal.ofReal on the right). Then, with D := B̆ⁿ_{r/2}(0) (open ball of ℝⁿ) and Bochner integrals: (E) for every j ∈ Fin k: ∫_D ‖Dfʲ(v)‖² dv ≤ 2e + a; (W) for every j ∈ Fin k, every C¹ function ζ : ℝⁿ → ℝ with compact support and tsupport ζ ⊆ D, and every G ∈ ℝ with ‖Dζ(v)‖ ≤ G for all v: |∫_D Σ_{i=1}^{n} ∂_ifʲ(v)∂_iζ(v) dv| ≤ G((2 + 2^{n+1}k)(e + a) + κrm), where ∂_ig(v) := (fderiv ℝ g v)(e_i).
